_readme: Settings for the khata and paper website. Real values only: leave a value empty until it is confirmed; empty values are not shown on the site.
_launched_readme: false = the pages ask search engines not to index them and are left out of the main sitemap. Set true once the brand name, contacts and prices below are confirmed.

brand._readme: WORKING TITLE. Replace both names with the real brand before launch; they appear in the header, on the ream wrapper, on khata back covers and in the order memo.

contact._readme: All empty = no contact block is shown and the order memo can only be copied. whatsapp_number: digits only with country code (8801…), turns on the 'Send on WhatsApp' button.

_prices_readme: All amounts are in BDT and come from the founders' first draft (November 2026). show_prices false = no amount appears anywhere; the calculators then only build a quote request.

school._readme: Unit price = base_by_pages + gsm_extra (+ combo_extra for the 3-in-1 ruling) − the first qty_discounts row whose quantity is reached. free_design_from: 0 hides the free cover design offer.

a4._readme: Rate per ream = base − volume discount − schedule discount.

ring._readme: packs: pieces → pack price. free_delivery_pack: 0 hides the free delivery offer. cod: true shows 'cash on delivery'.
